ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. This site-based course is for EOL SELP and CCEL EdD students. The course begins Sep 5 and ends Dec 6. Class sessions will be held at the Oak Brook, Multi-University Center on the following four weekends: September 5 and 6, Oct 3 and 4, Oct 31 and Nov1, and Dec 5 and 6. The four Friday evening sessions will be held from 5:00 to 8:30 PM, and Saturday sessions will be held from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: Graduate - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $441.00 per Bill Hour, and Graduate - Urbana-Champaign OCE Fees $41.00 per Bill Hour.
